newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 5.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 5.

text.p: These are the main headlines of the news stories reported by Radio Latvia on Thursday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkey fully supports Latvia's NATO aspirations, said Turkish President Suleyman Demirel, on a two-day visit.
- German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel has said the Baltic states are not looking for a separate status which would exclude the three from NATO membership at a later stage.
- The Baltic assembly in Vilnius concentrated on the issue of Baltic unity on the path to EU integration.
